name: Required Submission 3
definition: Specifies the details relative to the submission of the insurance data set.

Submitter.name: Submitter
Submitter.definition: Specifies with party(ies) is authorised to submit the data set as part of the transaction.

MatchIssuer.name: Match Issuer
MatchIssuer.definition: Specifies if the issuer must be matched as part of the validation of the data set.

MatchIssueDate.name: Match Issue Date
MatchIssueDate.definition: Specifies if the issue date must be matched as part of the validation of the data set.

MatchTransport.name: Match Transport
MatchTransport.definition: Specifies if the transport information must be matched as part of the validation of the data set.

MatchAmount.name: Match Amount
MatchAmount.definition: Specifies if the insured amount must be matched as part of the validation of the data set.

ClausesRequired.name: Clauses Required
ClausesRequired.definition: Specifies which clauses are required in the insurance data set.

MatchAssuredParty.name: Match Assured Party
MatchAssuredParty.definition: Specifies if the assured (insured) party must be matched as part of the validation of the data set.
